programs.title: Hawaizaada
programs.desc: The film which is based on the life on an Indian scientist Shivkar Bapuji Talpade, who is credited to have constructed India's first unmanned plane is the tale of the hardships that he went through on the journey to discover. Also the film is set in the pre-independence era of Bombay of 1895.

programs.title: Ramji Londonwaley
programs.desc: Ramji, a docile cook from a small Indian town, arrives in London for work only to find out that his employer is dead. He is further saddled with immigration issues that force him to marry.

programs.title: Shagird
programs.desc: A rookie cop questions the tactics of his superior, and attempts to track the abductors of his girlfriend.
